text: Approve For Me 是面向 DSH Web 的提权请求审核插件：它在审批请求流程中调用已配置的 reviewer 模型，并提供 Accept Only 与 Accept & Refuse 两种模式。模型判为允许时可自动批准；高风险或审核失败时，前者交回人工决定，后者自动拒绝。设置页可选择提供方、模型和推理强度，聊天记录会显示审核结论与理由。适合希望减少日常提权确认、同时保留不同人工介入策略的 DSH Web 用户；需要配置 DSH 可用的 reviewer 模型。

Approve For Me reviews DSH Web permission escalation requests with a model. It offers Accept Only and Accept & Refuse modes, records decisions in chat, and sends denials or review failures to a person or rejects them based on the selected mode. Requires a reviewer model available through DSH.
想让 DSH 自动审核沙箱拒绝后发起的权限提升请求。
有没有办法让低风险的提权操作自动批准？
我希望高风险权限请求仍然交给我确认。
能否让模型判断提权请求后自动放行或拒绝？
DSH 的 reviewer 模型没配好时，审批还能回到人工处理吗？
我想在聊天记录里看到每次自动审批的结论和理由。
Can DSH review permission escalation requests with a model?
I want low-risk approval prompts handled automatically.
Approve For Me 审核提权请求：在选中相应权限模式时，将会话记录、工具名称和请求原因交给所选 reviewer 模型评估，并按结果自动批准或转入后续审批。
Approve For Me 提供两种审批模式：Accept Only 在拒绝或审核失败时交回人工，Accept & Refuse 则自动拒绝；模型允许时两种模式都会批准该次请求。
Approve For Me reviewer 设置：在设置页选择模型提供方、模型和可选推理强度；未配置完整模型时，请求回到人工审批。
Approve For Me 将审核模式、结论、风险等级和理由写入会话命令记录，并在聊天中呈现批准、拒绝或交回人工的结果。
dsh-approve-for-me README · Introduction：<div align="center">

dsh-approve-for-me README · dsh-approve-for-me：**Approve For Me · DeepSeek Harness 提权请求自动审批插件** [](LICENSE) [](https://github.com/watericetangcw/dsh-approve-for-me) **[English](README.en.md) · 简体中文** 当 DSH 里的智能体因权限不足而请求提权（沙箱提权、更高权限重试等）时，弹窗不再直接打断你——配置好的 reviewer 模型会先审一遍：**低风险请求自动批准**，高风险请求按你选择的模式交还人工或自动拒绝。普通提问和方案确认完全不受影响。

dsh-approve-for-me README · 🤖 两种审批模式：| 模式 | 低风险 | 高风险 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Approve For Me (Accept Only)** | 自动批准 | 交给你人工审批 |
| **Approve For Me (Accept & Refuse)** | 自动批准 | 自动拒绝，全程无需人工 |

dsh-approve-for-me README · 一键安装：一条命令即可安装或移除：

**Windows（PowerShell）**

```powershell
dsh-approve-for-me README · 安装：irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/watericetangcw/dsh-approve-for-me/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex

dsh-approve-for-me README · 移除：irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/watericetangcw/dsh-approve-for-me/main/scripts/uninstall.ps1 | iex
```

**Linux / macOS（bash）**

```bash
dsh-approve-for-me README · 安装：curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/watericetangcw/dsh-approve-for-me/main/scripts/install.sh | bash

dsh-approve-for-me README · 移除：curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/watericetangcw/dsh-approve-for-me/main/scripts/uninstall.sh | bash
```

脚本会自动完成下面「手动安装」的全部步骤：

1. 定位 `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/web/package.json`（未设置 `DSH_HOME` 时默认 `~/.dsh`）；
2. 把 `dsh-approve-for-me` 加入 `dependencies`，并将 bundle 入口插入正确位置（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` 之后、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` 之前），修改前自动备份为 `package.json.afm.bak`；
3. 在 `profiles/web` 下执行 `npm install`（检测到 `pnpm-lock.yaml` 时改用 `pnpm install`）；
4. 完成后提示重启。

dsh-approve-for-me README · 移除：安装完成后**重启 `dsh web`** 并刷新一次浏览器页面。脚本可重复执行，已安装时会自动跳过；也可以克隆仓库后在本地直接运行 `./scripts/install.sh`（Windows 为 `.\scripts\install.ps1`），此时使用本地源码、无需联网。想先审阅脚本？见 [scripts/install.sh](scripts/install.sh) 与 [scripts/install.ps1](scripts/install.ps1)。

dsh-approve-for-me README · 手动安装（备选）：如果想自己动手，也可以按下面的步骤手动安装：

1. 在 `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/web/package.json` 中加入依赖与 bundle 入口：

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-approve-for-me": "file:../path/to/dsh-approve-for-me"
  },

2. 在 `profiles/web` 目录下运行 `npm install`。
3. **重启 `dsh web`** 并刷新一次浏览器页面。

> ⚠️ **bundle 顺序很重要**：`dsh-approve-for-me` 必须位于 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` 之后、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` 之前，否则审批请求会被浏览器应答器先接管，插件会静默失效。

回滚：移除依赖与 bundle 入口，重新 `npm install` 并重启即可。

dsh-approve-for-me README · 🚦 使用流程：**① 配置 reviewer 模型** 打开 **设置 → Approve For Me**，选择模型提供方、模型与推理强度并保存（推理强度越高的模型评估越严谨，耗时也越长）： **② 切换到 Approve For Me 模式** 在输入框旁的模式选择器中，从 Read Only / Workspace Write / Full Access 等常规模式切换到 **Approve For Me (Accept Only)** 或 **Approve For Me (Accept & Refuse)**： **③ 正常对话，低风险自动放行**

dsh-approve-for-me README · 🚦 使用流程：继续像平时一样对话。智能体请求提权时，低风险请求会被 reviewer 自动批准，聊天流中出现绿色的「已批准」决策行，全程不需要你点任何东西： **④ 高风险请求，按模式分流** - **Accept Only 模式**：高风险请求交回给你。审批弹窗变成醒目的警告面板，展示风险与评估理由，由你选择「拒绝」或「仍要允许一次」；聊天流中同步出现红色「未通过 · 已提交人工审批」决策行：

dsh-approve-for-me README · 🚦 使用流程：- **Accept & Refuse 模式**：高风险请求被自动拒绝，聊天流中出现红色「已拒绝」决策行，无需人工介入。

> 💡 未配置 reviewer 模型时，两种 Approve For Me 模式会像 Workspace Write 一样走人工审批，不会卡住你的工作流。

dsh-approve-for-me README · 📖 模式对比：| 情况 | Accept Only | Accept & Refuse |
| --- | --- | --- |
| reviewer 判定低风险 | 自动批准 | 自动批准 |
| reviewer 判定高风险 | 提交人工审批（可拒绝或仍允许一次） | 自动拒绝 |
| reviewer 超时 / 报错 / 输出不合法 | 提交人工审批 | 自动拒绝（fail closed） |
| 未配置 reviewer | 人工审批 | 人工审批 |
| 请求被中断 | 取消 | 取消 |

dsh-approve-for-me README · dsh-approve-for-me：When an agent in DSH asks to escalate its permissions (sandbox escalations, wider-permission retries, and similar), the popup no longer interrupts you directly — a reviewer model you configure reviews the request first: **low-risk requests are auto-approved**, while high-risk ones are either handed back to you or auto-rejected, depending on the mode you pick. Plain questions and plan-mode confirmations are never touched.

dsh-approve-for-me README · 🤖 Two review modes：| Mode | Low risk | High risk |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Approve For Me (Accept Only)** | Auto-approve | Handed to you for manual review |
| **Approve For Me (Accept & Refuse)** | Auto-approve | Auto-reject, no manual step at all |

The scripts automate every step of the "Manual install" below:

dsh-approve-for-me README · Remove：Then **restart `dsh web`** and refresh the browser page once. The scripts are idempotent — running them again is a no-op once installed. You can also clone the repository and run `./scripts/install.sh` (or `.\scripts\install.ps1` on Windows) locally, which uses the local checkout and needs no network. Want to review the scripts first? See [scripts/install.sh](scripts/install.sh) and [scripts/install.ps1](scripts/install.ps1).

dsh-approve-for-me README · Manual install (alternative)：> ⚠️ **Bundle order matters**: `dsh-approve-for-me` must sit after `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` and before `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`, otherwise the browser answerer claims every approval first and the plugin silently does nothing.

To roll back: remove the dependency and the bundle entry, run `npm install` again, and restart.

dsh-approve-for-me README · 🚦 Usage flow：**① Configure the reviewer model** Open **Settings → Approve For Me**, pick the provider, model, and reasoning effort, and save (a higher reasoning effort reviews more rigorously but takes longer): **② Switch to an Approve For Me mode**

dsh-approve-for-me README · 🚦 Usage flow：In the mode selector next to the input box, switch from the regular modes (Read Only / Workspace Write / Full Access) to **Approve For Me (Accept Only)** or **Approve For Me (Accept & Refuse)**: **③ Chat as usual — low-risk requests pass automatically**

dsh-approve-for-me README · 🚦 Usage flow：Just keep talking to DSH. When the agent escalates, low-risk requests are auto-approved by the reviewer and a green "Approved" decision row appears in the chat — no clicks needed: **④ High-risk requests take the path your mode defines**

dsh-approve-for-me README · 🚦 Usage flow：- **Accept Only mode**: high-risk requests come back to you. The approval popup becomes a prominent warning panel showing the risk and the reviewer's rationale, where you choose **Reject** or **Allow once anyway**; a red "Not passed · escalated to you" decision row appears in the chat at the same time:
dsh-approve-for-me README · 🚦 Usage flow： - **Accept & Refuse mode**: high-risk requests are auto-rejected and a red "Rejected" decision row appears — no manual involvement.
dsh-approve-for-me README · 🚦 Usage flow：> 💡 With no reviewer model configured, both Approve For Me modes behave like Workspace Write (manual approval), so your workflow never gets stuck.

dsh-approve-for-me README · 📖 Mode comparison：| Situation | Accept Only | Accept & Refuse |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Reviewer says low risk | Auto-approve | Auto-approve |
| Reviewer says high risk | Manual review (reject or allow once) | Auto-reject |
| Reviewer timeout / error / invalid output | Manual review | Auto-reject (fail closed) |
| No reviewer configured | Manual approval | Manual approval |
| Request aborted | Cancelled | Cancelled |
